item.title: What to watch on Day 1 of the Milan Cortina Olympics: Men’s downhill medal race, Ilia Malinin skates
item.description: Saturday is officially Day 1 of the Games.

item.title: Steph Curry to miss third straight Warriors game with right knee injury
item.description: Golden State is 5-8 in games without Curry this season

item.title: Facing growth and existing needs, Chualar residents asked to weigh in
item.description: Planning for this, the County of Monterey Housing and Community Development Department has been working on the Chualar Community Plan to assess the community's needs and capacity for growth.

item.title: County prioritizes enforcement of unpermitted food vendors
item.description: The Environmental Health Bureau reports a recent increase in “pop-up” taco vendors, which they believe may be attributed to Senate Bill 972 which took effect in January 2023, decriminalizing sidewalk food vending.

item.title: Judge strikes down old Arizona abortion restrictions that clash with voter-backed guarantees
item.description: Arizona's Democratic attorney general supported the plaintiffs.

item.title: Pacific Grove Council discusses regulation options for e-bikes
item.description: During the council meeting Wednesday, the council discussed existing city code and how it applies to e-bikes, bicycles and other devices on the coastal recreational trail, in parks and in other public spaces. The discussion focused on enforcement challenges, safety concerns and whether current regulations reflect current usage.

item.title: Monterey County Rail Extension project nearer to Caltrain connection
item.description: The Monterey County Rail Extension project will extend passenger rail service from Santa Clara County south to Salinas in Monterey County. The project has already revitalized the downtown Salinas train station, completed in 2021, creating a new multimodal transportation hub there, as well as plans for similar hubs in the communities of Pajaro and Castroville.

item.title: Feds can’t withhold social service funds from 5 Democratic states amid fraud claims, judge rules
item.description: The affected states include California, Colorado, Illinois, Minnesota and New York.

item.title: Justice Department will allow lawmakers to see unredacted versions of released Epstein files
item.description: To access the files, lawmakers will need to give the Justice Department 24 hours’ notice.

item.title: Judge orders Trump administration to bring back 3 families deported to Honduras, other countries
item.description: The judge said the government relied on “lies, deception and coercion” to deport them.
